skill.summary: 自动记录并汇总多平台每日收入，支持趋势分析及CSV/JSON格式导出报告。

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Daily Income Logger.
- Supports manual entry of daily income from multiple platforms.
- Generates daily summary reports and weekly/monthly trend analyses.
- Allows data export in CSV/JSON formats.
- Stores all records locally in JSON files.
